column1: #  Phase 4b — literature-curated floral-scent genes in model scent species NOT in Ensembl Plants.
#  These species (Petunia, Antirrhinum/snapdragon, Rosa) are absent from Ensembl Plants Compara
#  (snapdragon is also absent from OrthoDB), so orthology cannot be pulled programmatically; this
#  table is curated from the primary literature and cross-referenced to our B. rapa scent routes.
#  CITATIONS ARE INDICATIVE — verify author/year/journal against the primary literature before
#  manuscript use. Web-verified anchors (this session): Verdonk 2005 PMID15805488 (PhODO1);
#  Nagegowda 2008 PMID18363779 (AmNES/LIS); Magnard 2015 PMID26138978 (RhNUDX1). Others are from
#  domain knowledge and may be off by a year/journal.
#  Columns: species | clade | gene | enzyme | route | volatile_product | family | reference
